'''Wyrmscraig''' is an island in [[The Lonely Sea]] located in the [[Unquiet Ocean]] that requires 62 [[Sailing]] to access. Designed as part of the [[Sailing]] skill expansion, it was the winning entry of the [[Update:Sailing Player Designed Island Winner|"Sailing Player-Designed Island" competition]] held in early 2026. The island is characterised by its unique basalt column geography and its ties to the [[Icyene]] race. The island is inhabited by humans, though a small group of trolls lives underground. Wyrms of various types dot both the surface and caves. The island's inhabitants prefer to keep to themselves, seeing outsiders with disdain unless they gain the trust of the village mayor.

On the island, players can start the quest [[Fallen From Grace]], which upon completion allows access to a repeatable mid-level boss, the [[Mad Angel]]. Additional features of the island include [[Mortimer]], a [[Slayer]] Master who exclusively assigns tasks with [[Superior slayer monster|superior Slayer monster]]s; [[golem crafting]], a [[Crafting]] method that makes use of [[hunter fur]]s; and [[goat hunting]], a [[Hunter]] method.

==Transportation==
* Sail with your ship and [[Docking point|dock]] at the island, requiring 62 [[Sailing]]
* Casting [[Teleport to Boat]] (if it's docked at the island, requiring 67 [[Magic]] and a [[Greater teleport focus (facility)|greater teleport focus]])
* [[Necklace of passage]] (after [[Fallen From Grace]])
* [[Slayer ring]] (after [[Fallen From Grace]])
* [[Ardeaglais teleport]] (after [[Fallen From Grace]], dropped by the [[Mad Angel]])

==History==
Long before Wyrmscraig was settled, it was inhabited by a [[dragonkin]] named [[Orthacas]]. They had witnessed the [[sunstone monolith]] fall from the sky and land on the island, and abandoned their projects to investigate it. They discovered the stone had mysterious regenerative qualities, and attempted to use it to create a new type of [[wyrm]]. It is not clear if they succeeded, but they are responsible for the presence of wyrms and [[lava strykewyrm]]s on the island.

The island was then left uninhabited until [[Lowerniel Drakan]]'s conquest of [[Hallowvale]] during the [[Third Age]]. [[Elessia]], an [[Icyene]] who was captured and subjected to [[vampyrification]], escaped and fled [[Hallowvale]] with her companions. Searching for both a cure and an isolated location where she could not hurt others, they soon discovered and settled on Wyrmscraig.

While on the island, the pyrophoroi experimented with the [[sunstone]], discovering it was very effective in the creation of golems, though they were not able to figure out how to command them. Elessia's condition continued to worsen; her companions, believing that she could be cleansed through faith, constructed the cathedral of [[Ardeaglais]] to serve as a place of worship. Ultimately, the cathedral would become her prison, the vampyrification running its course and transforming Elessia into a bloodthirsty beast.

Her companions remained on the island to make sure the church stayed sealed, and left her offerings of human blood to sustain her. Over time, knowledge of Elessia faded into myth, and she would come to be known only as the Mad Angel. Most residents of the island believed her to be just a folk tale, though some of the more superstitious islanders continued to leave her offerings of blood as tribute, believing the Mad Angel would serve as the island's protector in exchange. Recently, she gave into her hunger and killed a boy named [[Keenan]], and decided to leave the island so no one else would get hurt, leaving behind an [[Mad Angel|Icyene-shaped golem]] to defend it.

==Trivia==
[[File:Wyrmscraig logo.png|thumb|250px|The logo used to promote Wyrmscraig in social media and newsposts.]]
* Wyrmscraig was designed by the player ''ScreteMonge'' under the pseudonym ''RoseNMcGeet''.{{CiteReddit|author=ScreteMonge|url=https://www.reddit.com/r/2007scape/comments/1qtwfjw/wyrmscraig_a_player_designed_island_by/|title=Wyrmscraig {{!}} A Player Designed Island by ScreteMonge (aka RoseNMcGeet)|quote=Second: yes, I am “RoseNMcGeet,” which is an anagram of “ScreteMonge,” which is itself an anagram for something Secret and Gnomish.  I’m not a big name by any means, but I do have some good relations with the OSRS Team, and have even done some work for them in the past - including for Sailing (my last contract being over 2 years ago now; where did the time go?). As such, I thought it best to submit anonymously and avoid any bias seeping into the nomination process.|date=2 February 2026|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/27964089|archivedate=4 June 2026}}
** There are some [[Roses (Wyrmscraig)|roses]] on the southern end of the island with the examine text "RoseNMcGeet.".
* With the island drawing heavy inspiration from Irish landscapes and culture, the name "Wyrmscraig" is a combination of the Old English word wyrm with the Irish word craig and translates to "Wyrm's Rock".{{CiteNews|url=https://secure.runescape.com/m=news/wyrmscraig-launches-july-29?oldschool=1|title=Wyrmscraig Launches July 29!|newsdate=16 July 2026|quote=Wyrmscraig draws heavy inspiration from Irish landscapes and culture. The name itself translates to "Wyrm's Rock", combining the Old English wyrm with the Irish word craig ("rock").}}
* The island is known to locals as Cuil An Domainh which translates roughly to "The Corner of the World" in Irish.{{CiteGeneral|url=https://www.jagex.com/news/set-sail-for-adventure-%E2%80%93-old-school-runescape-unveils-new-area-wyrmscraig|quote=Far across the south-west sea of Gielinor lies the secluded island of Wyrmscraig. Known to the locals as Cuil An Domainh, its rugged mountainous terrain and highly aggressive wildlife make for the perfect place for adventurers to explore.|title=Set Sail For Adventure – Old School RuneScape Unveils New Area Wyrmscraig|accessdate=2026-08-26|author=Jagex Communications Team|date=2026-07-29|publisher=Jagex|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/27964486|archivedate=29 September 2026}}
** This name is never stated in game, and only appears in a press release announcing the release of Wyrmscraig.
